records.text: Michael Aquino joined the Church of Satan in 1969, became editor of The Cloven Hoof and a member of its governing Council of Nine, then left in 1975 to form the Temple of Set.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: this guy Aquino joined the Church of Satan. And in 1969, he then rose through the ranks of that church as the magister caverns of a fourth degree within the church hierarchy. He became the editor of the publication, The Cloven Hoof, and he sat on the governing council of the nine. In 1975, he left to form his own satanic church

verification.notes: Reference sources agree Aquino joined the Church of Satan in 1969, became editor of The Cloven Hoof and sat on its Council of Nine, then broke with the church in 1975 and founded the Temple of Set.

sources.title: Aquino, Michael A. 1946-
